messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick check-in after today's seed cohort push — some nice signs but a few questions.
Ben (Growth): Saw CTR on launch post at ~4.2% for the test creative. Signups from that cohort are trending higher.
Priya (Product): Do we know how many signups used the provided prompt templates vs creating their own?
Ethan (Analytics): Early telemetry: ~62% opened template pack, ~40% executed at least one template within 24h.
Rita (Ops): Are we routing webinar registrants into the credit experiment or keeping them separate?
Maya (Marketing): Plan was to route webinar registrants to credit arm B (higher credit) if they match mid-market tag. Need to lock rules.
Ben (Growth): Proposed routing rule: webinar_registrant + tag=mid_market -> credit=75, else credit=25, cap high-credit to 25% rollout.
Priya (Product): Add metric capture: avg tokens/post and % of sessions that reach the "first-success" funnel step.
Ethan (Analytics): Will add those metrics. Also propose a simple quality proxy: prompt length + number of follow-ups in a session.
Rita (Ops): I'll encode the routing as JSON and gate the rollout with feature-flag for 25% traffic. Alert if daily spend > $400 for that flag.
Maya (Marketing): On content: drafting two launch posts — 1) benchmark teaser (internal ranges only), 2) quickstart + templates. Will ping for review.
Ben (Growth): For newsletter CTA, let's A/B subject lines: "Try Redwood with 75 free credits" vs "Quickstart: templates + credits". Track open->signup conversion.
Priya (Product): Reminder to avoid publishing latency numbers we haven't finalized. Use phrasing like "fast responses for typical prompts" in public copy.
Ethan (Analytics): I'll instrument cohort attribution tag: catalyst_credit_orbit_v1. Use that across router, emails, and landing page.
Rita (Ops): Action items: implement router JSON + flag (today), set alert thresholds (today).
Maya (Marketing): I'll finish drafts and landing copy (EOD). Ben: set up email variants (tomorrow). Priya: confirm templates bundle and in-app labeling (tomorrow).
Ben (Growth): Targets: move 7-day activation up by +3pp and measure 14-day retention lift.
Maya (Marketing): Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT for readiness. Thanks all :sparkles:
